description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national budget motel chain located on Alaska Avenue in Dawson Creek, the southern terminus of the Alaska Highway and Mile Zero of one of cycling's most iconic long-distance routes. For touring cyclists completing or beginning the Alaska Highway journey, this motel offers a recognizable, consistent lodging option at a significant milestone destination. As a Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.

OSM confirms this is a motel tagged internet_access=wlan, but per rules OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so Wi-Fi is set to null. The phone number from OSM (+1-866-541-6880) and website URL could not be independently verified from the fetched content, which contained no contact details for this specific property.
